schemes.title: PM SVANidhi (Pradhan Mantri Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi)
schemes.ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
schemes.purpose: Collateral-free working capital credit facility for urban street vendors and micro-hawkers to expand their informal business operations.

tranches.condition: Initial working capital loan for eligible street vendors.
Eligible on timely or early repayment of the 1st loan tranche.
Eligible on successful repayment of the 2nd loan tranche.

financial_benefits.interest_subsidy: 7% per annum interest subsidy, credited quarterly directly to borrower's bank account via DBT.
financial_benefits.digital_cashback: Monthly cashback up to ₹1,200/year (up to ₹100/month) on eligible digital UPI transactions.

eligibility: Street vendors vending in Urban Local Bodies (ULBs), census towns, or peri-urban areas.
Possession of Certificate of Vending (CoV) or ID card issued by ULB / Town Vending Committee (TVC).
Vendors left out of survey can apply with Letter of Recommendation (LoR) issued by the ULB / TVC.
Applicant must be at least 18 years of age.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card (linked to active mobile number)
Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Vendor ID Card / Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in, through PM SVANidhi mobile app, or visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local bank branch.

schemes.title: Udyam Assist Platform (UAP) for Informal Micro Enterprises
schemes.purpose: Formalizes informal micro-enterprises and street vendors who do not have PAN or GST, providing an official Udyam Assist Certificate.
key_benefits: Grants Priority Sector Lending (PSL) status for bank credit.
Enables qualification for government credit guarantee and subsidy schemes.
schemes.eligibility: Informal micro-enterprises, hawkers, street vendors, and home-based artisans operating without formal business registration.
required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the business owner
schemes.how_to_apply: Registration is facilitated free of charge by Designated Agencies (Banks, NBFCs, CSCs). PM SVANidhi beneficiaries can directly download their UAP certificate from the PM SVANidhi portal.

platforms.name: Google Business Profile (Google Maps)
platforms.best_for: Local footfall, passersby discovery, nearby resident trust, search visibility for 'near me' queries.
listing_steps: Open Google Maps app or visit business.google.com.
Enter stall name (e.g., 'Camp Fresh Fruits - Pune').
Select primary category (e.g., 'Fruit and Vegetable Store' or 'Food Stand').
Pin the exact stall location on Google Maps.
Add operating hours (e.g., 7:00 AM - 8:00 PM) and phone number.
Upload 2-3 clear photos of your fresh cart and display board.
local_seo_tips: Include your specific landmark or locality in the business name (e.g., 'Main Market Road, Camp').
Encourage regular customers to leave 5-star ratings and brief reviews.
Update photos weekly with fresh stock to increase Google search ranking.

platforms.name: ONDC (Open Network for Digital Commerce)
platforms.best_for: Receiving digital delivery orders from buyers across Paytm, Magicpin, Mystore, and Pincode without high marketplace commissions.
listing_steps: Download an ONDC Seller Partner App (such as Mystore Seller App, Magicpin Merchant, or SellerApp).
Register with your mobile number and basic business profile.
Add bank account details for direct daily payouts.
Upload a simple catalogue with items, unit prices (per kg / per dozen), and daily stock availability.
Set your delivery radius (e.g., 1-3 km hyperlocal delivery) or self-pickup.
advantages: Much lower commission fees compared to traditional delivery aggregators.
Direct visibility across multiple buyer apps simultaneously.

platforms.name: Justdial & Local Directories
platforms.best_for: Bulk orders for local events, weddings, nearby restaurants, and office pantries.
listing_steps: Enter your mobile number, stall name, and address.
Verify OTP to activate your free listing.

features: SmartSpeaker voice alert in 10+ regional languages

upi_apps.name: Paytm for Business
features: All-in-one QR accepting Paytm, Google Pay, PhonePe, and BHIM

upi_apps.name: BHIM UPI
features: Direct bank-to-bank transfer with high security

qr_setup_steps: 1. Download your preferred Merchant App (Google Pay for Business or PhonePe Business) from Google Play Store.
2. Enter your bank-linked mobile number and verify via OTP.
3. Enter Business Name, Category ('Fruits & Vegetables' or 'Food Stand'), and Stall Address.
4. Enter Bank Account Number and IFSC Code for direct settlements.
6. Download the digital QR code immediately, or order a free physical QR standee for your cart.
